verdict.rationale: Kick supports bulk-style automation: AI auto-categorizes ~97% of transactions on sync, Rules apply automatically to every matching transaction going forward, multi-entity workspaces let you split a transaction across entities, and the MCP/CLI surface is documented to 'automate month-end checks, and build workflows that run across every workspace.' These collectively cover bulk processing of transactions/entities via automation and AI/MCP agents, though there's no explicit UI for manually selecting and batch-editing arbitrary item sets. Missing for 10: no documented bulk-select/bulk-edit UI action, no explicit example of an MCP call operating on hundreds of items at once, no independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk throughput.
